facts.fact: 女主在离家 ten years 后开车回到华盛顿老宅；她已不在纽约，也已与 Graham 分开。
facts.anchor: After ten years, I’ll be back in the very place that I happily ran away from.

facts.fact: 女主已无处可退：布鲁克林那座房子不再属于她，只能停在父母家门前。
facts.anchor: But what else am I supposed to do? Drive all the way back to Brooklyn? To the house I no longer own?

facts.fact: 女主给自己打气：这次要见的是父亲，以及父亲那位糟糕的妻子——继母 Eloise。
facts.anchor: it’s just my dad. Him and his horrible wife. But still, my dad.

facts.fact: 女主预判继母 Eloise 会吼她滚出去，只能盼父亲见到她会高兴、并站在她这边。
facts.anchor: Eloise is likely to scream at me and tell me to leave. My dad should be happy to see me…I think.

facts.fact: 女主临阵退缩，想改天再来、先打电话给父亲再谈。
facts.anchor: I’ll try again tomorrow. I’ll call my dad and talk to him first.

facts.fact: 转折点：女主还没走成，门锁转动令她僵在原地，父亲随即猛地开门、目瞪口呆地认出女儿。
facts.anchor: My dad swings open the door, his jaw open wide, as a glint springs to his eyes.

facts.fact: 父亲哽咽着唤出女儿的名字 Billie，女主又酸又松了口气，跟着落泪。
facts.anchor: His voice chokes as he speaks. “Billie?”

facts.fact: 父亲唤她 baby girl，父女紧紧相拥、越哭越凶。
